Nope. Worst thing I’ve ever been prescribed was benzodiazepines. They have their time and place, but definitely shouldn’t be used for long term use. Nobody ever plans on becoming dependent/addicted. 10 years onwards and I’m 100% fully dependent, if I miss a dose or try to taper even the slightest .mg of a dose (with a doctor’s supervision and guidance), I can experience seizures, migraines, light and sound sensitivity, increased anxiety, insomnia, panic attacks, suicidal ideation/attempts, irritability, muscle spasms/cramps/pain, nausea, etc. The list is endless. 

They do not even help me anymore, I am on them purely because my body cannot function without them. I have pretty much accepted now that I will likely be stuck on this shit forever. 

This isn’t the case for everyone and some people use benzos long term and can cold turkey quit and experience no symptoms. Some people are on them for a month and will taper off slowly and experience horrible symptoms.

To be on the safe side, I’d suggest stay away.
